jobs.occupation: Head of PMO / Chief of Projects (m/f/d) (Leiter/in - Projekt-/Programmmanagement)
jobs.description: AURELIUS is a global alternative investor, distinguished and widely recognised for its operational approach. It focuses on private markets, in particular Private Equity and Private Debt. Its key investment platforms include AURELIUS Opportunities V, AURELIUS European Opportunities IV, AUR Portfolio III and AURELIUS Growth (Wachstumskapital). AURELIUS has been growing significantly in recent years, especially expanding its global footprint, and today employs more than 400 professionals in 10 offices spanning Europe, North America and Asia.AURELIUS is driven by a spirit of entrepreneurship, with a collegiate, hands-on approach to complex projects. We are motivated, open, fun, and operate as a team of equals.Create impact with passion!For an AURELIUS’ portfolio company located in Bavaria we are looking for aHead of PMO / Chief of Projects (m/f/d)As a Head of PMO you will lead and professionalize the end-to-end Project Management / Delivery function across the EMEA utilities business, spanning residential and industrial energy tech, software, and analytics solutions. You will own delivery from project definition through mass production and customer rollout, integrating Sales, Product Management, R&D, NPI, Procurement, and Quality into one disciplined execution engine. Furthermore, you will transform a currently fragmented, product- and site-centric delivery model into a standardized, cross-BU project delivery organization with clear stage gates, transparent KPIs, and predictable outcomes. The Head of PMO will act as the single accountable owner like a “project CEO” for on-time, on-quality, and on-cost delivery of projects and new product introductions, and as the primary interface to major customers for delivery commitments. Your task is to drive execution discipline, cost control, and margin protection across the full project lifecycle. The role requires frequent travel.Responsibilities1. Project Delivery Leadership & Organizational Ownership- Lead and develop the EMEA Project Delivery organization across customer projects, NPI, and cross-BU solution programs- Define and implement the organizational setup, governance model, and PM career path, including near-/offshore delivery capacity- Build a balanced delivery organization combining hardware project management, software/solution delivery, and NPI program management- Ensure scalability, agility, and clear accountability across all delivery units and sites2. End-to-End Engineering Delivery- Own end-to-end delivery from project definition through development, industrialization, mass production ramp, and customer handover- Act as the single point of accountability for on-time, on-quality, on-cost execution of customer projects and NPIs- Drive execution discipline, cost control, and scalable delivery models across multi-site and multi-BU programs- Establish a common project lifecycle, stage-gate framework, and PMO standards applied consistently across electricity, gas, thermal, software, and analytics- Ensure robust project planning, risk management, change control, and claim management on all major programs- Chair stage-gate reviews and enforce go/no-go decisions against scope, schedule, cost, quality, and business case3. Cross-BU Solution Delivery (HW + SW + Analytics)- Lead delivery of integrated solutions combining residential and industrial meters, head-end software, and analytics offerings- Break down BU silos and orchestrate cross-BU program teams around customer outcomes, not product lines- Establish shared solution architectures and reusable delivery playbooks across product families- Ensure consistent solution scoping, pricing input, and delivery commitments across the portfolio4. NPI & Industrialization- Collaborate with Operations on NPI program management from early involvement design, to design freeze through pilot, ramp, and stable serial production- Ensure early and structured involvement of NPI, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality in R&D projects- Drive design-for-manufacturing, design-for-cost, and design-for-serviceability discipline into every new program- Manage ramp readiness: supply readiness, test coverage, production line qualification, and yield curves5. Cross-functional Collaboration- Act as the delivery counterpart to Product Management (portfolio & roadmap) and R&D (technology execution)- Partner with Sales and Customer Projects to translate customer commitments into feasible, margin-protected delivery plans- Provide delivery input into bids, contract negotiation, and commercial terms (milestones, LDs, acceptance criteria)- Collaborate with Procurement and SCM to secure supply, lead times, and cost targets for project ramp- Collaborate with Quality to embed quality gates and field-performance feedback into delivery governance- Align with Finance on project controlling, revenue recognition, milestone billing, and cash collection6. Financial & Resource Management- Own the project delivery cost base and the aggregated margin performance of the project portfolio- Drive project margin protection: budget adherence, contingency management, scope and change control- Optimize allocation of PM and delivery resources across customer projects and NPI programs- Drive build vs. buy vs. outsource decisions for delivery capacity, balancing control, cost, and flexibility- Support business cases and mid-term planning with realistic delivery assumptions and risk-adjusted estimates7. Transformation & Change Leadership- Lead transformation initiatives to increase delivery productivity, reduce time-to-market, and improve predictability- Standardize and digitalize PMO tooling (planning, reporting, risk, resource management)- Build a high-performance, accountable, and customer-centric delivery culture- Drive upskilling and certification of the PM community across hardware, software, and solution delivery8. Governance, Risk & Compliance- Ensure project delivery complies with contractual, regulatory, cybersecurity, and quality requirements- Establish transparent portfolio reporting to the CEO and executive team, including early warning on at-risk programs- Own risk register for the delivery portfolio and drive systematic mitigationYour ProfileProfessional Experience- Minimum 15+ years of experience in project, program, and delivery leadership, including senior roles (VP/SVP level) in an international, matrix organization- Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-functional delivery organizations spanning hardware, software, and integrated solutions- Significant experience in customer project delivery in a B2B environment (preferably utilities, energy, industrial technology, or telecom infrastructure)- Strong NPI and industrialization background: bringing new hardware and software products from development into serial production and customer rollout- Demonstrated success in owning end-to-end delivery from project definition to mass production and customer acceptance- Experience running structured stage-gate and PMO frameworks at scale, with measurable improvements in OTD, margin, and predictability- Solid commercial acumen: contract, bid, and claim management; project P&L ownership; milestone billing and working capital control- Experience in driving organizational transformation and productivity improvements (cost, efficiency, time-to-market)- Experience in global/multi-site setups, including near-/offshore delivery structures- Exposure to carve-out, integration, or major transformation programs (strong plus)Intercultural Experience- Proven leadership experience in international and cross-cultural environments, managing teams across multiple geographies- Strong experience in navigating matrix organizations and global governance structures- High level of cultural awareness, adaptability, and communication effectiveness at executive and customer level- Fluency in German and English is a prerequisitePersonal attributes- University degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field- Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus; recognized PM certifications (PMP, IPMA, PgMP, SAFe) are a plus- Strong technical understanding across hardware, embedded systems, software, and cloud/analytics solutions — able to challenge and steer technical trade-offs- Deep mastery of project and program management methods, stage-gate governance, and modern delivery models (Agile at scale, hybrid HW/SW delivery)- Proven ability to drive execution at scale in multi-site, distributed delivery organizations, including vendor and outsourcing management- Data-driven delivery mindset: use of KPIs, portfolio dashboards, and analytics to improve OTD, quality, and productivity- Strong business and P&L awareness, with ability to protect and expand project margin under commercial pressure- Ability to connect customer commitments, technical execution, and financial outcomes- Strong ROI orientation: able to challenge scope, prioritize based on value, and terminate programs that no longer meet hurdle rates- Strong decision-making capability under ambiguity, especially in evolving organizational and carve-out setups- Excellent stakeholder management skills across CEO / board level, customers, suppliers, and internal functions- High degree of resilience and change leadership capability in transformation environments- Ability to attract, develop, and retain top program and delivery talentErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Aufsicht, Leitung, Projektmanagement

At the Max Planck Institute for Comparative Public Law and International Law, scholars pursue research relating to fundamental issues and current developments in the areas of public international law, European Union law, and the constitutional and administrative law of individual states, together with numerous visiting scholars from all over the world. In its fields, our library is the largest in Europe and one of the most comprehensive in the world.The newly established Max Planck Research Group “Constellations of Global (Dis)Ordering” (DISORDER), headed by Dr. Gordon Friedrichs at the Max Planck Institute for Comparative Public Law and International Law in Heidelberg, invites applications for twoResearch Fellow positions (Doctoral Researchers) (x/f/m)with a preferred starting date of 1 January 2027 (the positions are funded for three years)The Max Planck Research Group “Constellations of Global (Dis)Ordering” (DISORDER) investigates how global order is transformed as states - particularly great and middle powers - pursue competing visions of the principles, rules and institutions that structure international relations amid intensifying geopolitical rivalry. The group conceptualizes these processes as constellations of global (dis)ordering through which states seek to advance their visions of order by creating, reshaping, connecting, bypassing, or disengaging from international institutions, building new formal or ad hoc institutional arrangements, and strategically leveraging economic and technological interdependence. DISORDER examines how such constellations emerge across the fields of security, economy, and technology, and what forms of global order they produce, transform, or erode.Job descriptionThe successful candidates will develop independent doctoral dissertation projects within the framework of the Max Planck Research Group “Constellations of Global (Dis)Ordering” (DISORDER). Their research should contribute to the group’s broader inquiry into how states pursue competing visions of global order through international institutions and how these processes reshape global order across different issue areas.Possible orientations of the doctoral projects include:- an actor-centred perspective, examining how a particular great or middle power pursues its vision of global order across different issue areas institutional settings; or- a domain-centred perspective, comparing how different states interact with and reshape international institutions within a particular field, such as security, economy, or technology.Potential empirical cases may include, but are not limited to, the United States, China, Russia, India, Brazil, Japan, and other international actors such as the European Union.The doctoral researchers will:- develop and conduct an original PhD project that contributes to the conceptual and empirical agenda of the DISORDER research group;- conduct empirical research using qualitative methods such as process tracing, qualitative content and discourse analysis, and semi-structured interviews;- contribute to the comparative and collaborative research activities of the group;- participate in research group meetings, workshops, conferences, and other academic activities;- present research findings at international conferences and prepare publications for peer-reviewed academic outlets;- contribute to the organization of workshops, conferences, and other activities of the research group and the MPIL.Your profile- An excellent Master’s degree or equivalent in Political Science, with a specialization in International Relations or Foreign Policy Analysis- A strong research interest in global order, international institutions, and great- and middle-power politics, including their foreign policies- A substantive interest in one or more of the group’s empirical issue areas (security, economy, and technology)- A strong interest in qualitative research and familiarity with relevant research methods- Excellent written and spoken English- Additional language skills and country- or region-specific expertise relevant to the proposed doctoral project are considered assets- The ability to conduct independent research while contributing actively to a collaborative research environmentWe offer- An attractive and international work environment with an unparalleled research infrastructure and a good working atmosphere- A varied, responsible and team-orientated job- Remuneration in accordance with the guidelines of the MPG funding agreements (65 per cent of EG13, TVöD-Bund)- Access to our world-leading library and a multitude of databases- A workplace that is easy to reach by public transport and free employee parking spaces- A job ticket for public transport- Offers for work-life balance and four affiliated daycare centresApplicationThe Max Planck Society has set itself the goal of employing more severely disabled people. Applications from severely disabled persons are expressly encouraged. The Max Planck Society strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from all backgrounds. Furthermore, the Max Planck Society aims to increase the proportion of women in areas where they are underrepresented. Women are therefore strongly encouraged to apply.Interested candidates are invited to submit their complete application exclusively via the online application system (https://jobs.mpil.de/3vrp7) available on our website by 22 November 2026.Applications should include a CV, a cover letter of no more than two pages, copies of relevant degree certificates and transcripts of records, a one-page summary of the applicant’s Master’s thesis, a five-page PhD project proposal that clearly relates to the research agenda of the DISORDER group and indicates which of the thematic orientations outlined above the proposed project primarily addresses, and two letters of recommendationThe documents will be deleted after the application process. The interviews will take place in late November/early December in person at the Max Planck Institute for Comparative Public Law and International Law in Heidelberg. Application expenses cannot be covered.For questions regarding the positions, please contact Dr. Gordon Friedrichs at friedrichs@mpil.de (https://mailto:friedrichs@mpil.de) .

jobs.occupation: Rare Disease Manager (Key Account Manager) for NF1, Middle East of Germany (all genders) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.Your Role: As a Rare Disease Manager (Key Account Manager) for Neurofibromatose Typ 1 (NF1) , you will be at the heart of transforming how patients with rare diseases access life-changing therapies — your work directly influences treatment pathways and outcomes for some of the most underserved patient populations. You will own your territory like a true entrepreneur, taking full accountability for strategy, execution, and sustainable business growth across hospitals, treatment centers, and referral networks. You will develop and execute customized strategic account plans that strengthen centers of excellence, optimize referral pathways, and accelerate time-to-treatment for patients in need. Building deep, trust-based partnerships with physicians, nurses, pharmacists, and multidisciplinary teams will be your daily currency — and you will do it with scientific credibility and genuine care. Leveraging your deep scientific expertise, you will engage healthcare professionals as a peer and trusted partner, translating complex clinical evidence into meaningful conversations that drive better standards of care. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional colleagues in Medical Affairs, Market Access, Marketing, and Commercial teams to align strategies and maximize impact across the healthcare ecosystem. Data is your compass: you will use CRM tools, market analytics, and territory business planning to identify opportunities, monitor performance, and continuously refine your approach. You will champion disease awareness and patient education initiatives, playing a key role in shaping the rare disease landscape in your region. Acting as the voice of the customer, you will bring actionable field insights back to the organization — directly influencing strategy at a national level. This is a rare opportunity to combine commercial excellence with genuine patient impact — if that drives you, this role was made for you.Your territory covers key hubs across the Middle East of Germany — mainly Dresden, Leipzig and Göttingen area — and ideally, you already call one of these regions home.Who You Are:- You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Biology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, Medicine, or a related life science field; a qualification as Pharmaceutical Representative per local regulatory requirements is a plus.- You bring at least 4–5 years of commercial experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare industry, with a proven track record in strategic account management and market development.- You have hands-on experience in rare disease environments and a strong understanding of the complex stakeholder dynamics involved.- You possess deep knowledge of healthcare systems, reimbursement pathways, and patient access processes, ideally with exposure to high-cost specialty therapies.- You are scientifically agile — able to engage with complex clinical data and translate it into compelling, compliant customer discussions.- You combine an entrepreneurial mindset with strong analytical capabilities, taking ownership of results and thriving in ambiguous, fast-evolving environments.- You are a skilled communicator and relationship builder, experienced in working across cross-functional teams and navigating complex stakeholder landscapes.- You are fluent in German and English and highly willing to travel within your territory, including overnight travel as required.- A valid driving license is required.What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support Earth Observation & Science projects within Space Systems, Airbus Defence and Space in Ottobrunn is looking for anOptical Architect (d/f/m)You will join a multicultural team of engineers specialized in the development of optical (sub-)systems working for Earth Observation & Science projects within Space Systems. These developments cover instruments for ESA, CNES, DLR and EU programmes across the spectral range from ultraviolet to thermal infrared. Examples include LIDARs (ATLID, MERLIN), Multi-Spectral Instruments (Sentinel-2 MSI, Sentinel-4, Sentinel-5) from the Copernicus programme, infrared instruments (LSTM, TRISHNA), meteorological instruments (IASI-NG and METimage) embarked on MetOp-SG, instruments for scientific missions like EUCLID, cameras embarked on LEO and GEO satellites, and national programmes.This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.Your locationOur site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria.Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.Our Benefits for You- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.Your tasks and responsibilities- Define and develop optical subsystem architecture and verification strategies for space-borne instruments in project phases B2, C, and D following defined processes.- Act as the main technical contact point for optical domain matters, supporting systems engineers on technological, design, verification, risk, cost, and schedule aspects.- Perform optical design and analysis, including stray light analysis, optical layout, tolerances, and stray light, thermal, and optical performance (STOP) budget allocations.- Coordinate optical subsystem engineering and Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT) activities across multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Thermal, Electrical, Detection-chain, Cleanliness).- Derive, consolidate, and maintain optical subsystem requirements in alignment with higher-level specifications (e.g., SRD, IRD) and verification plans.- Oversee subcontracted optical equipment procurement, reviewing data packages and test plans to ensure on-time, on-cost, and on-quality delivery.- Contribute to future programmes (phase 0 or A/B1), support internal/external R&D proposals for new optical technologies, and participate in lessons-learnt exchanges.Desired skills and qualifications- Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Optical Engineering- Proven multi-year experience in optical instrumentation or optical sensors, ideally for space applications- Solid experience in optical layout, design, tolerance, and STOP analysis, including maintenance of optical allocations/budgets.- Proficiency with commercial optical design software (e.g., Code V, Zemax, FRED) and programming languages (e.g., Matlab, Python).- Sound technical knowledge of optical components (e.g., mirrors, photonics, gratings, fibers, lasers, coatings) and space equipment alignment/testing strategies.- Strong communication skills, collaborative problem-solving approach, and experience in managing suppliers or subcontractors.- Professional working proficiency in English; knowledge of German is beneficial.Not a 100% match? jobs.description: WELCOME TO BASFIn Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented.WHAT YOU CAN EXPECTOur Regional Treasury EMEA department is responsible for the Treasury and Cash Management activity of BASF Group companies in the EMEA region. Within our Bank team, we are responsible for validating customer and supplier master data, ensuring adherence to internal Fraud Prevention requirements.- In your new role, you support the project team with day-to-day tasks such as mass changes.In addition, you are responsible for managing your own small projects from initiation through to full completion, as well as providing reports and supporting optimization projects.- The validation and preparation of new business partners form a core part of your responsibilities, along with various analyses and reports depending on requests and needs.- Besides that, you are ensuring that team knowledge, communications, and publications are kept up to date.- Lastly, you are in regular contact with various units across the BASF Group.- commercial vocational training or studies and first professional experience in the field of Master Data and working in projects- confident handling in working with SAP R/3, particularly in the FI module, as well as with MS Office- comprehensive knowledge of process flows, Business Partner master data workflow, products, customers and entity goals- strong analytical sense and an eye for details is required, goal-oriented, precise working methods and high customer orientation- fluent and convincing communication in English, further language skills are welcomeWHAT WE OFFER- Gross annual salary (full-time): 40.000 - 46.000 €, depending on qualifications and professional experience - In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success- 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options- Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs- Location-independent working models with defined days of presence in Berlin and residence in Germany - here a first impression- Work mobile from other EU countries for up to six weeksHOW TO REACH US- Katarina Borisov (Talent Acquisition), Tel: +49 30 2005-59269 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are welcome to book an online appointment.- You can also reach our recruiting team here.- First information about our application process can be found here and in our Q&A video.

Go beyond and create global impact: At Munich Re, we're proud to be one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, primary insurance, and insurance-related risk solutions. Our group is made up of the reinsurance and ERGO business segments, along with our asset management company, MEAG. We operate globally and are active in all lines of the insurance business.Since our founding in 1880, we've built a reputation for unrivalled risk-related expertise and a solid financial foundation. We use our strengths to support our clients' business goals and drive technological progress. We're also at the forefront of developing coverage for emerging risks, from rocket launches and renewable energy to cyber threats and artificial intelligence.With around 44,000 people worldwide, our group's corporate culture is defined by performance, mutual respect, and trust. All this makes us an attractive employer providing global career development opportunities and prospects.Credit risks are the main underwriting focus in EULA5. The Global Credit Solutions (GCS) team is writing business mainly with global banks by insuring credit risks originated by the banks, where the team assumes the role of a primary insurer. Your task as a Client Relation Risk Manager is to attract new bank clients, manage existing bank clients and writing proactive business within your responsibility. It is necessary to meet credit decision in conjunction with the Risk Underwriting (RUW).Your Job- Developing our global business by binding new transactions with new and existing clients- Establish new and foster existing client relationships, with focus on the global banks. Identify the relevant people within these organisations and establish a personal relationship- Negotiation and finalizing of insurance policies and Master Risk Participation Agreements with the global banks- Own risk assessments of the transactions offered by the banks, especially in the area of trade finance- Assessment of the banks capabilities in originating and assessing credit risks in all relevant trade finance productsYour Profile- University degree, preferably in business or economics, or equivalent training (banking traineeship followed by relevant further education)- Several years' professional experience within a bank or professional experience in the risk transfer market between banks and insurance companies in the field of Global Trade Finance- Proven track record in originating, structuring and closing trade finance and credit risk transactions directly with banks and/or corporates, combined with a demonstrated ability to generate new business opportunities and build long-term strategic client relationships across international markets- Several years of professional experience in client management and the acquisition and development of international banking and corporate clients- Strong business development capabilities, including the ability to identify new market opportunities, expand market presence and establish strategic partnerships in key trade finance markets- Demonstrated experience in establishing, developing and scaling new business areas, products, platforms or market initiatives, ideally in an international environment- Deep understanding of global trade finance products, risk mitigation structures and relevant international markets- Strong commercial mindset combined with sound risk assessment capabilities, relationship management skills and the ability to successfully execute complex transactions- Superior analytical skills in conjunction with a pronounced risk awareness and sense of responsibility, along with a willingness and ability to justify decisions in a clear and comprehensible manner- Team-oriented, entrepreneurial and solution-driven personality with a high degree of initiative and the ability to work independently- Business-level English required; additional excellent foreign-language skills an advantage- Confident manner, high degree of social skills when interacting with colleagues, clients or in-house interfacesApplication InstructionsPlease apply through our online portal and upload your CV, as well as your academic reference letters, including school certificates, graduation certificates and transcripts of record for any degrees. If applicable, please also submit reference letters from any previous employers or certificates from any other qualifications you may have. We recommend writing a cover letter to tell us more about why the position and Munich Re is of interest to you.About usAs the world's leading reinsurance company with more than 16,000 employees at over 50 locations, Munich Re introduces a paradigm shift in the way you think about insurance. By turning uncertainty into a manageable risk we enable fundamental change. Join us working on topics today that will concern society tomorrow, whether that be climate change, major construction projects, medical risk assessment or even space travel.Together we embrace a culture where multiskilled teams dare to think big. We create the new and the different for our clients and cultivate innovation.Sounds like you? Push boundaries with us and be part of Munich Re.Our employees are our greatest strength. That's why we offer them a wide range of benefits. You can find some examples below.Unlock your potential- Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: we embrace the power of differences and are convinced that diversity fosters innovation and resilience and enables us to act braver and better.- Continuous Learning: we believe that continuous learning is a key differentiator and critical for building new skills and accelerating growth.- Career Mobility: we actively support career mobility, and our strong global and regional presence offers a wealth of career growth opportunities for you.Rewards & Recognition- Competitive salary: appropriate compensation for your high level of commitment.- Retirement provision: state of the art in-house pension solutions.- Work-life balance: promoting the compatibility of family and work in addition to overall work-life balance.- Health management: focus on your physical and mental health far beyond legal requirements.- Hybrid working: living the best of both worlds - we offer you a very flexible approach as well as the opportunity to work from abroad on an occasional basis.- Munich Re not only stands for fairness with regard to its clients; it is also an equal opportunities employer. Severely disabled candidates will also be prioritized, if equally qualified.Münchener Rückversicherungs-GesellschaftLeonie JohnsonTalent Acquisition Partner

Referenznummer: CON-GER-PER-SBAAssociate Consultant (m/f/d)Target Group: Young ProfessionalDepartment: ConsultingWHAT WE DO - AND WHYFEV Consulting is the FEV Group's technology-driven top management consultancy. We act as a guide between strategy development and product realization in today's global environment. We do not simply work for companies, but for our customers - people who want to move society forward. That's why we develop and optimize technical product concepts with our focus on customer benefit, feasibility, sustainability and profitability.We are looking for committed team players. Together with us and our customers, you will actively shape the future of mobility and the energy industry. You can expect a varied and exciting working day filled with challenging questions to tackle. You will be joining a strong, collaborative team and will benefit from our international and interdisciplinary environment.You provide support on technical and strategic tasks in interdisciplinary teams of consultants and technical specialistsYour daily tasks include the analysis and evaluation of complex issuesYou create management-ready presentations of resultsYou take over the planning and preparation of expert interviews and workshops and actively participate in themYou support our working students in their personal developmentYou are interested in innovative products and future technologies and have a passion for sustainable mobility and energyYou have completed your studies at a top university with exceptional achievements and impress us with your personal profileIdeally, you have already had initial practical experience in management consulting or a technical industryIn addition to your excellent analytical and conceptual skills, you have a high level of creativityYou enjoy working independently on projects and driving them forward as part of a teamYou communicate fluently in both English and German and possess intercultural experienceYou identify with our company values - customer focus, professionalism, commitment, open-mindedness and respectAn appreciative and contemporary corporate cultureWe want to create a positive working environment. In our international teams, you work flexibly on sustainable topics. Through our open feedback culture, you can really help shape the company. We are made up of diverse personalities who love to celebrate our successes together. We work in flat hierarchies and have an open-door policy from student to CEO because we think that rigid hierarchies are yesterday's news. We also give you the freedom to grow personally and professionally. Because we want to actively support you on your career path, we offer a mentoring program for all colleagues.Diverse career prospectsYou can shape your career with us according to your own ideas. We give you the time and space to develop your potential at home or abroad at one of our many locations. Internal and external training opportunities allow you to discover or perfect your strengths.Work-life balanceWe are convinced that only a satisfied team can perform outstanding work. That's why we trust you to contribute to the company in a flexible and self-organized way. We do not have a classic consultant week. A good balance between office and remote work supports you in organizing your professional life and free time in a flexible way.Additional benefitsWith us, you will receive the classic benefits such as 30 days of vacation, capital-forming benefits (i.e. retirement plans), employee discounts and sabbaticals. However, we are constantly expanding these benefits, because appreciation means more to us than just offering the bare minimum.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung
